source: Vivienne’s Jazz Cafe Has Lost Its Beat
target: 薇薇安爵士咖啡館失去節拍

source:
Vivienne’s Jazz Cafe was raided in the late hours of yesterday’s evening. A federal sting operation involving three agents had confirmed the distribution and sale of alcohol from the premises and its owner, Miss Claudette Vivienne, was arrested on charges of racketeering and corruption.

Federal agents witnessed 18 instances of alcohol sales, and it is anticipated that Ms. Vivienne will thus face 18 counts of violating The National Prohibition Act – fines are not to exceed $5000 for each violation and/or one year of jail time. Local prosecutors and District Judge Chester W. Pembroke have not shown a shred of leniency towards prohibition criminals.

According to legal correspondent Kerrigan Mulhew, Esq., “I would expect Ms. Vivienne to be prosecuted to the maximum extent of the law, most likely resulting in the federal repossession of her illicit business as payment for fines in addition to 18 years of incarceration. Undoubtedly, she will be made an example of.” 

Ms. Vivienne could not be reached for comment, though onlookers report that she bellowed a celebrated battle cry before stepping into the paddy wagon: “Vive la résistance!”
target:
薇薇安爵士咖啡館昨夜遭到突襲搜查。一項由三名探員參與的聯邦誘捕行動，證實該場所分銷及販售酒類。老闆克勞黛特・薇薇安小姐因涉嫌有組織犯罪與貪腐而被捕。

聯邦探員親眼目睹十八次售酒行為，因此薇薇安小姐預計將面臨十八項違反《全國禁酒法》的指控，每項違規可處最高五千美元罰款、一年監禁，或兩者併罰。地方檢察官與地區法官切斯特・W・彭布羅克，對違反禁酒令者一向毫不寬貸。

法律特派員凱瑞根・穆休律師表示：「我預期薇薇安小姐將受到法律允許的最嚴厲追訴，極可能被聯邦政府沒收非法營業場所，充抵罰款，此外還要入獄十八年。毫無疑問，她會被用來殺雞儆猴。」

本報未能聯絡薇薇安小姐取得回應，但旁觀者表示，她在登上囚車前，高喊了一句著名的戰鬥口號：「反抗萬歲！」

source: A Lesson From the Ancient Peoples of Mt. Ulysses
target: 尤里西斯山古代居民給我們的一課

source: Our editors note that the following is a full-page ad paid for by a Mr. Quentin P. Brown who is not affiliated with the Asbury Pines Bulletin. Open letter to the good people of Asbury Pines, My name is Quentin P. Brown, a Professor of Archaeology at Lincoln University. My fascination with the early neolithic people of North America brought me to your town about three years ago. Since then, I made one of the most important discoveries of our generation (and it wasn’t Ms. Dagney Truitt’s blackberry cobbler). Dear neighbors, at the base of your Mt. Ulysses lived an ancient people who can teach us something enlightening. A people who valued the cultivation of something we all aspire to grow: empathy. Or as we know it, “love for thy neighbor.” How did such people transcend the strife and squabbles that came with surviving a time of mammoths, dire wolves, and warring migrators? What was their secret? Help me find it. For all our sake. In the face of modern stresses, I understand how easy it is to shrug off the past as trivial facts. We, as a people, are taught to keep our eyes looking forward like a horse wearing blinders. We focus on the idea of progress in all our environments: growing a family, advancing a career, protecting a community, empowering a nation. But movement without direction can keep us trodding in a circle, an illusion of advancement where there is none. Why, not long ago, the people of Germany thought they were furthering a mighty cause when in fact they were advancing baseless ideas of racial hierarchies. You see, our ideas of progress change our culture, and culture changes our daily life – but not always for the better. So, how can we ensure our progress truly drives us to better places? Understanding cultural shifts from good to bad or bad to good is the compass that can guide our human evolution in an uplifting direction. Understanding means taking off the blinders and looking back to see where we’ve been, learning all the ways we went from good to bad and, even more importantly, the ways we went from bad to good to amazing. Be honest with yourself. Do you not feel that war is wrong? Do you not feel that inequities cause harm? Do you not feel that we can aspire to more? What if a society discovered how to aspire in ways we have not yet imagined, and we were sitting on top of their answers? We learned democracy through Greek letters. Important mathematics from Chinese scrolls. Spiritual philosophy from Egyptians burial sites. Why deny ourselves of a lifetime opportunity to advance who we can be? I urge you all to fight the construction of this bunker that threatens to snuff out this little flame of immense hope burning at the base of Mt. Ulysses. The past holds answers. The past is who we are today! Join me, next Monday at dawn, to protest the bunker’s scheduled construction. We don’t need this project. We all struggle sometimes, and we could all use answers. Resist with me, for all our sake. Your neighbor, Quentin P. Brown
target: 編輯部註：以下為昆汀・P・布朗先生付費刊登的全版廣告。布朗先生與《阿斯伯里松林鎮公報》並無關聯。 致阿斯伯里松林鎮善良居民的公開信： 我叫昆汀・P・布朗，是林肯大學考古學教授。對北美洲新石器時代早期居民的著迷，讓我大約三年前來到貴鎮。此後，我做出了我們這一代最重要的發現之一（而且不是達格妮・特魯伊特女士的黑莓酥皮甜點）。 親愛的鄰居們，在尤里西斯山腳下，曾住著一群古人，他們能教給我們一些啟發人心的事。他們重視培養一樣我們都渴望增進的東西：同理心。也就是我們所說的「愛你的鄰人」。 在長毛象、恐狼與征戰遷徙者的年代求生，這群人如何超越隨之而來的紛爭與衝突？他們的祕密是什麼？幫我找到它吧。為了我們所有人。 面對現代生活的壓力，我明白，要把過去當成無關緊要的瑣事，一笑置之，有多容易。我們被教導，要像戴著眼罩的馬一樣，眼睛只看前方。在生活各方面，我們專注於進步：建立家庭、發展事業、保護社區、壯大國家。但沒有方向的移動，可能只讓我們繞圈子，明明原地踏步，卻以為自己前進了。不久前，德國人民以為自己在推動一項偉大事業，實際上卻在助長毫無根據的種族階序觀念。 你們看，我們對進步的想法改變文化，文化又改變日常生活——但並不總是變好。那麼，如何確保我們的進步，真的把我們帶往更好的地方？ 理解文化如何由好轉壞、由壞轉好，就是能引導人類往正面方向演進的羅盤。理解，意味著摘下眼罩，回頭看看走過的路，學習我們如何從好變壞，更重要的是，如何從壞變好，再變得卓越。 誠實面對自己。你難道不覺得戰爭是錯的？不覺得不平等會造成傷害？不覺得我們可以追求更多？如果有個社會，找到了我們尚未想像過的追求方式，而我們正坐在他們的答案之上呢？ 我們從希臘文字學會民主，從中國卷軸學會重要的數學，從埃及墓葬學會心靈哲學。為什麼要拒絕這個千載難逢的機會，讓我們成為更好的人？ 我懇請各位，反對這座碉堡的興建。它正威脅著尤里西斯山腳下，那簇承載巨大希望的小小火苗。過去藏著答案。過去成就了今天的我們！ 下週一黎明，請與我一起，抗議碉堡預定展開的施工。我們不需要這項工程。我們都有難熬的時候，也都需要答案。為了所有人，和我一起反抗。 你們的鄰居， 昆汀・P・布朗

source: Daisy Pond Red From Deadly Militia Clash

In the early hours of yesterday morning, another bloody clash between independent militia groups left 10 dead and 17 wounded. The third eruption of violence in four months, this battle at Daisy Pond was the deadliest yet and, according to information ascertained from electric telegraph, has spurred Governor Retlidge to request President Rutherford B. Hayes for assistance from the National Guard. 

All persons wounded and killed were from the White Man’s League, a self-described club seeking political results that oppose freedmen. Senior Constable Heller arrested all able-bodied wounded and suspected militants of the League, whilst the other militia group, known locally as the Johnny Trackers, had no dead or wounded on the field. With regard to the Johnny Trackers, even now their agenda remains unknown, though it is widely believed they are freedmen who once served as riflemen and sharpshooters under Captain Elijah B. Quail. Following the end of our nation's Civil War, Mr. Quail has lived on the outskirts of town as a turkey farmer.  

It is anticipated that the presence of the National Guard will quell these skirmishes once and for all, as they have in Louisiana. Though, judging by the fierceness of our local militia, it seems the town of Asbury is determined to oppose the likes of radicalism displayed by groups like the White Man’s League.
target:
昨日凌晨，獨立民兵團體間再度爆發血腥衝突，造成十人死亡、十七人受傷。這是四個月內第三次暴力事件，發生於雛菊池的這場戰鬥，也是迄今最致命的一次。據電報消息，雷特利奇州長因此向拉瑟福・B・海斯總統請求國民兵支援。

死傷者全數來自白人聯盟，該團體自稱是追求反對獲釋奴隸之政治成果的俱樂部。資深警官赫勒逮捕了所有尚能行動的傷者與涉嫌參戰的聯盟成員；另一支在本地被稱為「強尼追蹤者」的民兵，則未在戰場留下任何死傷者。強尼追蹤者的目的至今仍不明朗，但外界普遍認為，他們是曾在以利亞・B・奎爾上尉麾下擔任步槍兵與神射手的獲釋奴隸。我國內戰結束後，奎爾先生便住在鎮郊，以飼養火雞為生。

預料國民兵的到來，將如他們在路易斯安那州所做的一樣，徹底平息這些衝突。不過，從本地民兵的強悍表現看來，阿斯伯里鎮似乎決心抵抗白人聯盟這類團體展現的激進主義。

source: Manhunt Commences for Missing Girl, Reward Announced
target: 失蹤女孩搜尋行動展開，家屬宣布懸賞

source:
For the second day, local authorities actively search for missing girl Sadie Sloan: age nine, red-blonde hair, green eyes, last wearing a navy blue dress, and last seen near pine woods due north of town hall. No traces of evidence have yet been found. She is daughter of Mr. Finn and Mrs. Bernadette Sloan. Mr. Sloan is offering a reward of five hundred dollars for any information that leads to the location of his missing daughter. 

Volunteer search parties and opportunistic trackers have arrived in droves from neighboring counties. 

Mr.  Sloan provided brief commentary, alleging that the local cabaret and morally harmful outlets in town would likely promote such sickening crime. He asks for prayers and God’s mercy.  

Contact Senior Constable Theodore Heller with any information that may aid in finding or leading to the whereabouts of Sadie Sloan.
target:
地方當局搜尋失蹤女孩莎蒂・斯隆的行動，已進入第二天。莎蒂九歲，金紅色頭髮、綠眼睛，最後身穿海軍藍洋裝，出現在市政廳正北方的松林附近。目前尚未找到任何線索。她是芬恩與柏娜黛特・斯隆夫婦的女兒。斯隆先生懸賞五百美元，徵求能協助找到女兒下落的消息。

志願搜救隊與希望獲得賞金的追蹤者，已從鄰近各郡成群趕來。

斯隆先生簡短發言，指稱本地歌舞表演酒館，以及鎮上傷風敗俗的場所，很可能助長這類令人作嘔的犯罪。他請求大家祈禱，祈求上帝憐憫。

任何可能協助尋獲莎蒂・斯隆、或指向其下落的消息，請聯絡資深警官西奧多・赫勒。

source: Concrete Baron Smeed Pours Own Grave
target: 混凝土大亨斯米德澆築自己的墳墓

source:
Hugo “Huck” Smeed, eccentric inventor and owner of SMEED Concrete, poured himself into a concrete coffin beside the Asbury Public Library. Discovered two days ago by a groundskeeper, all that remained around this makeshift mausoleum was a box containing a manifesto expounding Mr. Smeed’s “misunderstood genius.” 

Known more commonly as “Crazy Huck” and “No Luck Huck,” Mr. Smeed had hired a small crew and forged city permits to excavate his burial pit under the guise of preparing a “drainage structure.” He cordoned the area and, according to his manifesto, imbibed an arsenic mixture prior to the concrete pour and clutched to his chest a metal box that contained a journal of his utopian imaginings and the proprietary secret for making SMEED concrete – a legitimately top-grade building compound. 

Asbury Town Council and Mayor Vernon have consulted Chief Engineer Paul Crenshaw on the dangers the grave poses to the library foundation and structure, which is nearly complete following Mr. Crenshaw’s guidance to raise the walls and erect a flattened, wood roof. Mr. Crenshaw advised it would be more trouble to get through the concrete block than to cover it with earth and move on.

Mr. Smeed left our world with a sullied reputation, legacy, and bank account. Finn Sloan, owner of Sloan’s Loans and Savings, confirmed that the concrete baron had exhausted his business and personal accounts a year ago to fund frivolous lawsuits attempting to regain control of the public library project. The manifesto revealed the yammering of a destitute megalomaniac who was determined to “outlive all of this wretched town.” 

It appears he was correct and will outlive us all, though only as the town’s favorite joke.
target:
古怪發明家、斯米德混凝土公司老闆雨果「哈克」斯米德，在阿斯伯里公共圖書館旁，將自己澆封於混凝土棺中。兩天前，一名園地管理員發現這座臨時陵墓，周圍只留下一只盒子，內有一份宣言，闡述斯米德先生「不被理解的天才」。

斯米德先生更常被稱為「瘋哈克」或「倒楣哈克」。他雇用一小隊工人，偽造市府許可，以準備「排水設施」為名，挖掘自己的墓穴。他封鎖現場，並在宣言中表示，自己在澆灌混凝土前喝下含砷混合物，胸前緊抱一個金屬盒。盒裡裝著記錄烏托邦幻想的日記，以及斯米德混凝土的獨家製造祕方——那確實是一種頂級建材。

阿斯伯里鎮議會與維農鎮長，已就墳墓對圖書館地基和結構的風險，諮詢總工程師保羅・克倫肖。圖書館依克倫肖先生的指示，增高牆面、架設平坦木屋頂，目前已接近完工。克倫肖先生建議，鑿穿混凝土塊，比覆土掩埋、不再追究還要麻煩。

斯米德先生離世時，名聲、功績與銀行帳戶都已狼狽不堪。斯隆貸款儲蓄銀行老闆芬恩・斯隆證實，這位混凝土大亨一年前就耗盡了公司與個人帳戶的資金，投入毫無意義的訴訟，試圖奪回公共圖書館工程的主導權。宣言展現的，是一個窮困潦倒、妄自尊大之人的喋喋不休，決心要「比這座可悲城鎮的一切都活得更久」。

看來，他說對了，的確會比我們所有人活得更久——不過，只會以全鎮最愛的笑話之姿。
